name: list_repository_issues
summary: a repository's issues, a page at a time, without the pull requests GitHub lists among them.

name: create_issue
summary: a new issue in a repository.

name: get_issue
summary: an issue, by number.

name: update_issue
summary: an issue's title, text, state, assignees, labels or milestone changed.

name: list_repository_labels
summary: the labels a repository has, a page at a time.

name: create_label
summary: a new label in a repository.

name: list_issue_labels
summary: the labels on an issue, a page at a time.

name: add_issue_labels
summary: labels added to an issue, beside those it has.

name: set_issue_labels
summary: an issue's labels replaced with those given.

name: remove_issue_label
summary: one label taken off an issue.

name: clear_issue_labels
summary: every label taken off an issue.

name: add_issue_assignees
summary: people assigned to an issue, beside those assigned now.

name: remove_issue_assignees
summary: people no longer assigned to an issue.

name: lock_issue
summary: an issue's conversation locked, so only collaborators can comment.

name: unlock_issue
summary: an issue's conversation unlocked.

name: list_issue_comments
summary: the comments on an issue, a page at a time.

name: create_issue_comment
summary: a new comment on an issue.

name: search_issues_and_pull_requests
summary: issues and pull requests found with GitHub's search syntax, structured filters, or both.

name: list_issue_timeline_events
summary: everything on an issue's timeline, a page at a time.

name: list_issue_events
summary: what happened to an issue, a page at a time.

name: list_repository_issue_events
summary: what happened to every issue in a repository, a page at a time.

name: list_milestones
summary: a repository's milestones, a page at a time.

name: get_milestone
summary: a milestone, by number.

name: create_milestone
summary: a new milestone in a repository.

name: update_milestone
summary: a milestone's title, state, description or due date changed.

name: delete_milestone
summary: a milestone deleted from a repository.

name: get_issue_comment
summary: a comment on an issue, by id.

name: update_issue_comment
summary: a comment on an issue, its text replaced.

name: delete_issue_comment
summary: a comment on an issue deleted.

name: get_label
summary: a repository's label, by name.

name: update_label
summary: a label renamed, recolored or described anew.

name: delete_label
summary: a label deleted from a repository.

name: list_assignees
summary: the people issues in a repository can be assigned to, a page at a time.

name: create_issue_reaction
summary: a reaction to an issue.

name: create_issue_comment_reaction
summary: a reaction to a comment on an issue.
